main.description: A sigil crafted in the Anisota Lab's Sigil studio and saved to the owner's library. Each record stores the finished figure as a standalone SVG (for display and re-export) and its normalised 'core path' as integer coordinates (x and y interleaved, scaled 0..1000) — the single line a sigil is, and the shape a future gesture-passcode could be matched against. 'method' records which bench made it (intent, square, wheel or draw).

meta.description: Optional method-specific details (e.g. the word, planet, seed or settings used)

points.description: The normalised core path: x and y interleaved, each scaled to 0..1000

svg.description: A standalone SVG document of the finished figure
